name: Cyberhaven - Create or Update Incident
description: Creates a Datadog Incident for each Cyberhaven incident the first time its id is seen, and updates the existing Datadog Incident on every later version. Lookup is by the source_incident_id field. Triggered by the [Cyberhaven] Incident created or updated monitor.

parameters.name: script
description
parameters.value: Reads the Cyberhaven incident id from the monitor alert group (@cyberhaven.incident.id).

parameters.name: script
description
parameters.value: Builds the Datadog incident title, severity, state, summary and property fields from the newest Cyberhaven incident log, and diffs it against the previous version to fill Last Change.

parameters.name: script
description
parameters.value: Confirms which search result carries this exact Cyberhaven incident id in its source_incident_id field, so a create-or-update decision is never made on a partial match.

parameters.name: message
parameters.value: Could not read the Cyberhaven incident logs for incident {{ Steps.Parse_group.data.id }} from Datadog Logs after 3 retries. No Datadog incident was created or updated.
